store.21: I've been involved in undergraduate research since the end of my sophomore year, and it's been one of the most eye-opening parts of my college experience. It's given me a glimpse into how knowledge is created in the tech world, and it's pretty cool to be part of that. As a freshman, I didn't see myself going down the research route. I was into coding projects and hackathons, but I didn't think of research as 'my thing.' However, one of my professors, who taught an introductory data science class, noticed my ability to bridge technical coding with user experience. She told me about an opening for a research assistant in a lab focused on data visualization for big scientific datasets. I was initially hesitant because research seemed intimidating. But I took the leap, and it turned out to be a great decision.
